subject: Air freight quote: FRA–DEL
body:
Hi,

Could you quote an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option to DEL (Delhi, IN)?

We’ll deliver the shipment to FRA ourselves. It’ll be ready on 2026-11-24: 11 pieces of printed marketing material, 736 kg gross, 6.88 cbm.

Thanks

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech
